nodes.title: Number and bool refusals name the value type
nodes.summary: The two refusals in parseAttributeValue that carried only the value (a number that is not finite, a bool that is not true or false) now carry the value and its value type in their details, as the regex-shape number refusal and the date refusals already did.

nodes.title: Proof for the number and bool refusals naming the value type
nodes.summary: Tests that a refused number-typed or bool-typed attribute proposal is refused with VALIDATION_INVALID_FORMAT naming the value and its value type, over REST as HTTP 200 carrying { ok: false, error }, with the value judged as text by the stated number and bool expressions.
